Bone broth can help ease hangover symptoms by rehydrating your body and replacing lost electrolytes like sodium and potassium . It is also warm, easy to digest, and gentle on a nauseous stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF16SZAaiHHyR0PyRDeI2N1npGoCU8TOonvo6H0fDOPiU2iljFawS593KT-dbjzF8UqP4-0hH0h_Obm3f5bSiAIVK3BrULAlvS7MUVnOwkrboboOHYs2d3MDJaveB33VtxIcvSRq_pLgECUnWYCPISj4tZi6_GocdN-BWvI84)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF13xj4iSu1pzzTURK-l8jdi6aksyWJCKX329SIj5WIMUlrq36ps_Wi7_hHrSvh6HQ_rAd34n1wi4OQyJ-RlSJgYNoGDEWVbTne1DoOFLCSsYlRJlHCZQ74ZVZcsR0TqMfxJfaPKliGUUxNIJjO0mDwJ_hwV7LUB8v7j49b1dsYC2MxcpB4QQuDATCk_ZWqJTa8WzChP56qA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXNwE3c9qY9bPF4TnkBph0iI-CWSFv0M5uaKKisCvvMOB4c63R6iFvS7cJSkXLYZKH4K4TypY6DVfUcbiSaVNcOzVvHI3X8YXi6mp1AkBWFj5TMC-aYS1mDwWLyGWfTXvAvX1sGX0N1oCey3mQ)

### Why It Helps

- **Rehydration and electrolytes:** Alcohol acts as a diuretic and depletes fluids and minerals; salty broth helps restore balance.
- **Easy on the stomach:** Warm liquids are often easier to tolerate than heavy meals when you feel nauseous.
- **Protein and amino acids:** Simmering bones releases collagen, gelatin, and amino acids, which support general recovery and gut comfort.
- **No cure-all:** While it supports comfort and hydration, time, water, and rest are still what clear alcohol and its byproducts from your system.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXNwE3c9qY9bPF4TnkBph0iI-CWSFv0M5uaKKisCvvMOB4c63R6iFvS7cJSkXLYZKH4K4TypY6DVfUcbiSaVNcOzVvHI3X8YXi6mp1AkBWFj5TMC-aYS1mDwWLyGWfTXvAvX1sGX0N1oCey3mQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF16SZAaiHHyR0PyRDeI2N1npGoCU8TOonvo6H0fDOPiU2iljFawS593KT-dbjzF8UqP4-0hH0h_Obm3f5bSiAIVK3BrULAlvS7MUVnOwkrboboOHYs2d3MDJaveB33VtxIcvSRq_pLgECUnWYCPISj4tZi6_GocdN-BWvI84)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF13xj4iSu1pzzTURK-l8jdi6aksyWJCKX329SIj5WIMUlrq36ps_Wi7_hHrSvh6HQ_rAd34n1wi4OQyJ-RlSJgYNoGDEWVbTne1DoOFLCSsYlRJlHCZQ74ZVZcsR0TqMfxJfaPKliGUUxNIJjO0mDwJ_hwV7LUB8v7j49b1dsYC2MxcpB4QQuDATCk_ZWqJTa8WzChP56qA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXzcYwKH4G1x7fpB_-e6sbqbywWtDG0S8fCpjoetuSaahB_er32UKw6W96K4R-TAMKEqmCN-UN-Xeyh9RNTU-_75xPZw6D94ljm1iD_sgCpOntzSRL0sJibdmAdydq_1lXHqZq90MWC5Z2ldgJ1cALKxWAcWGmyw)

### How to Use It

- **Sip it warm:** Heat store-bought (boxed or frozen) or homemade bone broth on the stove or in the microwave.
- **Pair with bland carbs:** If your blood sugar is low or your stomach feels unsettled, pair a mug with toast or white rice.
- **Alternate with plain water:** Broth contains sodium, so drinking plain water alongside it helps prevent excess salt intake while keeping you hydrated.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF130ucYGibWc3p2IR_ccSIHycho3_OTyADe5ds2ip0X8VDPUMmW-ElQe8-dGjLfNPNp_q96-wUC4mmVS10cEzOLEdao62NcEXwmvAkGLS9gzOHNU6Ul38-FD4A8PDUrUMdbJInFxTmNot5LZVEQdvsZ8nFQxqH9IfGTtVrhAD4vNutrDJuYZXbN4ECALaUVQ_Cl_FftjBvY7B1nWE8JP1CA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXNwE3c9qY9bPF4TnkBph0iI-CWSFv0M5uaKKisCvvMOB4c63R6iFvS7cJSkXLYZKH4K4TypY6DVfUcbiSaVNcOzVvHI3X8YXi6mp1AkBWFj5TMC-aYS1mDwWLyGWfTXvAvX1sGX0N1oCey3mQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF13xj4iSu1pzzTURK-l8jdi6aksyWJCKX329SIj5WIMUlrq36ps_Wi7_hHrSvh6HQ_rAd34n1wi4OQyJ-RlSJgYNoGDEWVbTne1DoOFLCSsYlRJlHCZQ74ZVZcsR0TqMfxJfaPKliGUUxNIJjO0mDwJ_hwV7LUB8v7j49b1dsYC2MxcpB4QQuDATCk_ZWqJTa8WzChP56qA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF16SZAaiHHyR0PyRDeI2N1npGoCU8TOonvo6H0fDOPiU2iljFawS593KT-dbjzF8UqP4-0hH0h_Obm3f5bSiAIVK3BrULAlvS7MUVnOwkrboboOHYs2d3MDJaveB33VtxIcvSRq_pLgECUnWYCPISj4tZi6_GocdN-BWvI84)
